# How-to guides

## Working method
Read the selected opportunity, audience, voice and existing pages. Preserve observed demand evidence. Agree on the brief before drafting: reader question, query, intent, evidence, fit, proof, next action and owner.

Use the content-production skill and the shape below with judgment. Keep the draft, sources and assets beside its owning brief. Avoid duplicate records in Notion or other systems unless that destination is explicitly chosen.

## Review
Verify consequential facts and links. Use real, inspected screenshots when they help; preserve editable sources, attribution and owner-approved designs. Review desktop and mobile previews in the chosen publishing format. Keep internal checks outside the article. The owner approves publish readiness; no automatic merge or publication.

## Suggested shape
Promise a concrete outcome. Give prerequisites and the environment, numbered actions, exact examples, expected results and a verification step. Test the procedure where possible and distinguish untested examples. Explain genuine troubleshooting cases. Do not omit prerequisites just to make the process appear easy.
